text:
As you walk down the street, an
ominous-looking black car revs up
and charges at you. Make a L4 Save,at +1 if you are Agile, +2 if  Agile at
Expert level. If you fail, lose 2 Life.
If you pass the first save, you may
move out of the street and avoid
further attacks. If the car hits you,
you are knocked down and the car
will try to run over you (make
another Save as above, with the
same consequences).
If you have a grenade, you may use
it to destroy the car and recover 1
Sanity as you do so. If you destroy
the car, that is a 1 in 6 chance of a
demon appearing and attacking
you.
Demon, L6, 8 Life, flying (you may
not escape from this fight).
Susceptible to holy water and
exorcism. When the demon first
appears, save vs. L4 Fear or lose 1
Sanity.
If you destroy the car, you find 1
random enchanted item in the
wrecked vehicle (roll on the
Enchanted Item table).

zh-CN.title: 3 - 附身汽车
text:
你走在街上，一辆阴森的黑色汽车突然发动，朝你猛冲过来。进行一次L4防御检定；敏捷技能加+1，敏捷达到专家级加+2。失败则失去2点生命。第一次检定成功后，你可以躲到街边，避开后续撞击。如果汽车撞到你，你会被撞倒，汽车接着试图碾过你；按同样方式再进行一次防御检定，失败后果也相同。
如果你有手榴弹，可以用它摧毁汽车，并因此恢复1点理智。摧毁汽车时，有1/6的概率出现一只恶魔并攻击你。
恶魔：L6，8点生命，会飞（这场战斗中不能逃跑）。易受圣水和驱魔术影响。恶魔首次出现时，进行一次L4恐惧防御检定，失败则失去1点理智。
摧毁汽车后，你可以在残骸中找到1件随机附魔物品（掷附魔物品表）。
